junctions.interpretation: LAB15 outer-balance is not a safety signal: fresh junctions are highly outer-balanced and highly coherent, so LAB15 strongly opens on them.

glyph_stencil.sparse_harm: Although whole-case LAB15 gate activation is tiny, harmful glyph pixels are a selective high-coherence/high-monotonicity subset; sparse leakage is sufficient to cause large case PSNR loss.

texture_frequency.interpretation: The three fresh texture/frequency families occupy substantially lower coherence than fresh junctions and slanted structural strokes, while always-on MC was strongly beneficial on all 18 texture cases in LAB16.

structural_pixel_separation.note: No individual audited zero-fetch feature is a strong local harm classifier across all structural pixels; architecture should therefore use conservative conjunctions rather than treat one feature as an oracle.

architecture_implication: Test a conservative texture-admission router that starts from v01 and admits MC primarily in lower-coherence, supported/monotone texture regions instead of trying to make outer-balance itself a universal safety gate.
